## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `paypal-payments-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a sandbox business account

1. <!-- manual: Open the [PayPal Developer Dashboard](https://developer.paypal.com/dashboard). -->
2. Under **Testing Tools**, select **Sandbox Accounts**.
3. Select **Create account** and choose **Business** as the account type.

## Step 3: Create a REST API app

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Apps & Credentials tab. -->
2. Select **Create App**, provide a name, and select the sandbox business account you created.
3. <!-- manual: Select Create App, provide a name, and select the sandbox business account you created. -->
